reason_for_new_study: The frozen V3 interface cannot be produced prospectively because CMASKL, MEANGBL and USFLUXL are absent from both SHARP NRT series. The bounded sibling-series equivalence probe failed its live-availability gate. This study therefore uses a separately named causal interface rather than mutating V3.
sampled_label_semantics: previous primary >=10 MeV proton sample below 10 pfu and a later sample at or above 10 pfu within (issue, issue+24h], subject to the frozen V2 outcome coverage rules

historical_archive_reference: NOAA/NCEI GOES 1-15 operational or science-quality archive where applicable

checks: historical XRS files are retrievable from an official NOAA/NCEI archive and contain documented timestamps, units, quality fields and the required XRS bands

historical proton files are retrievable from an official NOAA/NCEI archive and contain documented timestamps, units, quality fields and a defensible >=10 MeV integral-proton quantity or a preregistered derivation whose semantics are fixed before labels are inspected
the routing rule from archived satellites to one forecast-time XRS stream and one forecast-time proton stream is explicit, deterministic and independent of target outcomes
source timestamps can be converted to UTC without using observations published after each forecast issue
quality/missing flags are preserved rather than converted to ordinary numeric measurements
cadence, duplicate timestamps, maximum gaps and period of record are measured before training
the common historical coverage period and chronological role boundaries are frozen using coverage/timestamp information only, before event labels or model scores are inspected

xrs_features: per documented XRS band: finite count, coverage fraction, minimum, maximum, mean, median, standard deviation, last causal value, time since last causal value
long-band threshold exceedance counts at fixed physical flux levels declared in implementation before modeling
maximum causal first difference and maximum causal log-flux change using only ordered past observations
proton_features: for the >=10 MeV integral-proton stream: finite count, coverage fraction, minimum, maximum, mean, median, standard deviation, last causal value, time since last causal value
fixed counts of past samples at or above 1, 5 and 8 pfu; 10 pfu is not used as a predictor threshold at issue times already ineligible
maximum causal first difference and maximum causal log-flux change using only ordered past observations
missingness_features: age of most recent valid observation by family

primary.description: one lightweight XGBoost classifier on the frozen causal XRS+proton summary interface

comparators.rule: same fixed XGBoost hyperparameters and seeds using only the frozen XRS feature family
same fixed XGBoost hyperparameters and seeds using only the frozen proton feature family
constant probability equal to positive prevalence in the fit role only
no probability/alert when the preregistered source freshness or minimum-coverage rule is not met

roles.construction_rule: After the data-readiness gate passes, derive one chronological common-coverage timeline. Freeze chronological fit/calibration/threshold/score boundaries from timestamps and coverage only; do not inspect labels to move boundaries.
roles.calibration: single logit-intercept calibration only; no model refit
roles.threshold: select primary MAX_TSS threshold; separately select POD80_MIN_FAR diagnostic threshold
roles.score: one development comparison on the frozen same eligible cohort
roles.future_prospective: forecasts issued only after the complete package, source rules and thresholds are frozen; future outcomes are not used for tuning

metrics.uncertainty: paired block/bootstrap intervals using independent chronological event/quiet units rather than IID issue rows wherever support permits

primary_improvement_criterion.reference: best simple non-abstaining available-input comparator on the identical eligible score cohort
primary_improvement_criterion.rule: All three conditions must hold together. The 20% false-alert ambition may not be relaxed after viewing the score result. Abstentions on positive eligible issues count against missed-crossing performance rather than disappearing from the denominator.

interpretation_if_primary_criterion_fail: Report the exact tradeoff and negative result. Do not tune another filter, move thresholds, alter coverage rules or rename the study as successful.
claim_boundary: This preregistration authorizes a separate causal NOAA reduced-input development study after source readiness passes. It does not establish independent superiority, operational certification, catalogue-event equivalence, economic impact, or award outcome.
